title: darkFlash C280 E-ATX Dual Chamber Case, Black (4 PWM Fans)

comparisons.notes: Exact match: DF-C280-EBKR4BK, C280 black, 4 x PWM fans; Shopify available=true at $109.99

writeup: This new darkFlash C280 E-ATX dual-chamber case in black (model DF-C280-EBKR4BK) is $54.99 and includes four PWM fans. It is a dual-chamber E-ATX chassis with vertical GPU mounting and clearance for a 420mm radiator. darkFlash Official has the same black, 4-fan C280 in stock on their site at $109.99, so this is 50% and about $55 below the live market price. Woot showed 10+ left, with a limit of 10 per customer.
amazon_match_notes: Verifier marked amazon_asin_verified B0GL243DXZ as an exact match for the new darkFlash C280 black with 4 PWM fans (DF-C280-EBKR4BK).
